fidelity: F2a — Flash Thermodynamics with Lumped Separator/Turbine ODE
source: DiPippo, R. (2015). Geothermal Power Plants, 4th ed., Butterworth-Heinemann, Ch. 5-6 (single/double flash). Water/steam saturation & enthalpy correlations: IAPWS-IF97 simplified region-4 fits (Wagner & Pruss 2002).

unit.name: Generic Single-Flash Geothermal Plant — Physics-Lumped Flash Thermodynamics

T_flash_design.note: Flash separator temperature; optimum ~ geometric mean of source/condenser T

T_condenser_offset.note: Condenser saturation T above rejection T (pinch)

m_dot_brine_design.note: Total geofluid mass flow from production wells

cp_brine.note: Approx specific heat of liquid geothermal brine at ~200 C

eta_turbine_isentropic.note: Steam turbine isentropic efficiency (DiPippo Ch.5 typical 0.75-0.85)

P_rated.note: Nameplate net electrical capacity at design

tau_separator.note: Lumped separator pressure/level first-order time constant
